title: cynara humilis var. leucantha
intro: Cynara humilis var. leucantha, commonly known as the White Cardoon, is a plant species belonging to the thistle family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynara humilis var. leucantha include its ability to protect the liver and kidneys, as well as its potential to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
